caption: The video captures a low-angle close-up of a road roller's drum assembly moving over grey asphalt. The dark curved metal shell, rusty circular hub, and yellow mounting bracket remain framed together as pavement texture streams past beneath them. A thin black flap protrudes from the right edge of the shell, staying attached throughout. At the upper right, a strip of green grass and a pale curb move out of view, leaving grey asphalt as the dominant background. Small bits of debris on the ground drift downward and toward the lower edge, showing continuous forward motion of the roller. The hub's bolt holes and the shell's faint surface marks hold nearly constant positions within the frame, so the view travels with the machine rather than sweeping across a stationary object. The roller advances steadily along the pavement, with the drum assembly occupying most of the left and central view while the open asphalt extends to the right under dappled sunlight.
